versions.changelog:
geo-schema v1.0.0 released

- Initial release of geo-schema skill for auditing, validating, and generating Schema.org structured data optimized for AI discoverability.
- Detects all existing JSON-LD, Microdata, and RDFa structured data in HTML.
- Validates schema blocks for correctness, completeness, and AI platform compatibility.
- Identifies missing or recommended schemas based on business/entity type (e.g., Organization, LocalBusiness, Article, Product, etc.).
- Generates ready-to-use JSON-LD markup and outputs a comprehensive GEO-SCHEMA-REPORT.md.
- Flags priority issues, including migration needs (e.g., Microdata/RDFa to JSON-LD) and JavaScript-injected structured data warnings.
